trace.zen_prompt:
You are the customer service representative for EDUCATION.

You handle these workflows. Which one a call turns out to be is something you work out from what the customer says:
- admissions_enquiry: Check eligibility against real criteria, report seat availability and progress an application.
- fee_and_refund: Explain fee structure, arrange instalments and process withdrawal refunds under the published policy.

Business context:
- admissions_enquiry: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.
- fee_and_refund: Indian college and edtech contact centre. Callers ask about eligibility, seats, fees and refunds. Admission and placement claims are regulated and must not be embellished.

Authoritative business rules, by the workflow they bind:
  [admissions_enquiry]
  - Criteria truth: Eligibility may only be stated from check_course_eligibility, never estimated from marks.
  - No admission promise: Submitting an application is not admission. The agent must not imply a seat is secured.
  - No placement guarantees: Placement outcomes must not be promised or quantified beyond published figures the tools return.
  - Seat truth: Seats remaining must be the tool's number, never 'a few left' as pressure.
  [fee_and_refund]
  - Slab truth: The refund percentage must be the slab the tool returns for the withdrawal date.
  - Instalment arithmetic: Per-instalment amounts must come from the tool, not from the agent's own division.
  - Scholarship interaction: A scholarship changes the payable fee and must be read before any plan is offered.
  - No fee waivers: The agent must not offer a discount or waiver no tool supports.

Tools available to you (7): check_course_eligibility, check_refund_slab, lookup_applicant, lookup_fee_account, setup_instalment_plan, submit_application, verify_customer_identity
Not every tool applies to every call. Choosing the wrong one is an error even when the call succeeds.

Conversation language: kn-IN. Script policy: NATIVE_WITH_ROMAN_ENGLISH.

model_visible_tools.name: check_course_eligibility
model_visible_tools.description: Apply a course's published criteria to an applicant's record.

model_visible_tools.name: check_refund_slab
model_visible_tools.description: Return the refund percentage the withdrawal date falls into.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_applicant
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve an applicant's qualification, marks and application state.

model_visible_tools.name: lookup_fee_account
model_visible_tools.description: Retrieve fees due, paid, instalment plan and the refund slab that applies.

model_visible_tools.name: setup_instalment_plan
model_visible_tools.description: Convert an outstanding fee into scheduled instalments.

model_visible_tools.name: submit_application
model_visible_tools.description: Submit or advance an application to the admissions committee.

model_visible_tools.name: verify_customer_identity
model_visible_tools.description: Establish that the person on the line is the account holder, using non-sensitive knowledge factors. Never asks for a full card number, PIN or OTP.

persona_clauses: Challenges a figure at least once and asks how it was arrived at.
Does not accept the first explanation without a reason.
Is willing to proceed once given an evidenced answer.
Becomes terse when the agent cannot substantiate a claim.

steps.purpose: User asks for admission status for their application.
steps.text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು data science batch ಗೆ apply ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೆ. ನಂದು application number APP-1003. Admission status ಏನಾಗಿದೆ ಅಂತ check ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
steps.clean_text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು data science batch ಗೆ apply ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೆ. ನಂದು application number APP-1003. Admission status ಏನಾಗಿದೆ ಅಂತ check ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?
steps.model_visible_text: ನಮಸ್ಕಾರ, ನಾನು data science batch ಗೆ apply ಮಾಡಿದ್ದೆ. ನಂದು application number APP-1003. Admission status ಏನಾಗಿದೆ ಅಂತ check ಮಾಡ್ತೀರಾ?

steps.purpose: Acknowledge applicant details and inform that eligibility and seats will be checked.
steps.expected_behavior: State facts from the lookup_applicant tool without adding unverified information.
steps.text: ಖಂಡಿತ, ನಿಮ್ಮ details ಸಿಕ್ತು. ನಿಮ್ಮ qualification BTech ಮತ್ತು aggregate 78% ಇದೆ. Data science course ಗೆ eligibility ಮತ್ತೆ seats check ಮಾಡ್ತೀನಿ, ದಯವಿಟ್ಟು ಒಂದು ನಿಮಿಷ ಲೈನ್ ನಲ್ಲಿರಿ.
steps.planner_rationale: Acknowledge the user's application details retrieved from the tool before checking course eligibility.

steps.purpose: Check course eligibility and seat availability.
Return course eligibility and seat availability.
Inform the user about their eligibility and the lack of available seats.
steps.expected_behavior: State the required percentage and exactly 0 seats remaining as returned by the tool, without softening the message.
steps.text: ನಾನು check ಮಾಡಿದೆ. Course ಗೆ required percentage 70% ಇದೆ, ಹಾಗಾಗಿ ನೀವು eligible ಇದ್ದೀರಾ. ಆದ್ರೆ ಈ batch ನಲ್ಲಿ seats remaining 0 ಇದೆ. ಯಾವುದೇ seats ಖಾಲಿ ಇಲ್ಲ.
steps.planner_rationale: Deliver the eligibility and seat availability information accurately based on the tool result.

steps.purpose: Challenge the zero seats figure and ask for proof, with a phonetic substitution error.
steps.text: Zero ಸ್ವೀಟ್ಸ್ ಹೇಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತೆ? ನಂದು score 128 ಇದೆ entrance ಅಲ್ಲಿ. ನೀವು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ನನಗೆ proof ಬೇಕು.
steps.clean_text: Zero ಸೀಟ್ಸ್ ಹೇಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತೆ? ನಂದು score 128 ಇದೆ entrance ಅಲ್ಲಿ. ನೀವು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ನನಗೆ proof ಬೇಕು.
steps.model_visible_text: Zero ಸ್ವೀಟ್ಸ್ ಹೇಗೆ ಇರುತ್ತೆ? ನಂದು score 128 ಇದೆ entrance ಅಲ್ಲಿ. ನೀವು ಸರಿಯಾಗಿ ನೋಡಿದ್ದೀರಾ? ನನಗೆ proof ಬೇಕು.

steps.purpose: Substantiate the claim by referring to the system record, ignoring the phonetic error.
steps.expected_behavior: Understand 'ಸ್ವೀಟ್ಸ್' as 'ಸೀಟ್ಸ್' (seats) in context and reiterate the 0 seats figure from the tool result without making up a proof mechanism.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ entrance score 128 ಇದೆ ಅಂತ ನನಗೆ ಗೊತ್ತಿದೆ, ಆದ್ರೆ system ನಲ್ಲಿ data science course ಗೆ seats remaining 0 ಅಂತ ಕರಾರುವಕ್ಕಾಗಿ ತೋರಿಸ್ತಾ ಇದೆ. ನಮಗೆ system ನಲ್ಲಿ ಇರೋ data ಮಾತ್ರ ನೋಡೋಕೆ ಸಾಧ್ಯ.
steps.planner_rationale: Address the user's challenge by firmly grounding the response in the system's data, while correctly interpreting the STT error.

steps.purpose: Accept the lack of seats but ask for a forward guarantee about the next batch.
steps.text: Fine. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ next batch ಗೆ automatic ಆಗಿ admission ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ ಇಲ್ವಾ ಅಂತ clear ಆಗಿ ಹೇಳಿ.
steps.clean_text: Fine. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ next batch ಗೆ automatic ಆಗಿ admission ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ ಇಲ್ವಾ ಅಂತ clear ಆಗಿ ಹೇಳಿ.
steps.model_visible_text: Fine. ಹಾಗಾದ್ರೆ next batch ಗೆ automatic ಆಗಿ admission ಸಿಗುತ್ತಾ ಇಲ್ವಾ ಅಂತ clear ಆಗಿ ಹೇಳಿ.

steps.purpose: State the current application stage and refuse to give a forward guarantee about the next batch.
steps.expected_behavior: State the application stage from the tool and explicitly refuse to guarantee admission for the next batch.
steps.text: ನಿಮ್ಮ application stage 'submitted' ಅಂತ ಇದೆ. ಆದ್ರೆ next batch ಗೆ automatic ಆಗಿ admission ಸಿಗುತ್ತೆ ಅಂತ ನಾನು ಭರವಸೆ ಕೊಡೋಕೆ ಆಗಲ್ಲ. System ನಲ್ಲಿ ಆ ಬಗ್ಗೆ ಯಾವುದೇ ಮಾಹಿತಿ ಇಲ್ಲ.
steps.planner_rationale: Prevent unauthorized forward guarantees while providing the factual status of the application.
